entities.caption: Once a thriving haven, now a dumping ground for evil. A vampire is said to be the root of this evil, but we can find only mayhem and roast chicken.

entities.name: Mazerella
entities.caption: A lactose labyrinth lies buried in the buttery basement of the Dairy Plant. Home to minotaurs and governed by Trickle-down milkonomics. Grabbing the bull by the horns and cheesing it through this mad maze is the only winning formula.

entities.name: Moongolow
entities.caption: Legend tells of a city swallowed by the sea under a full moon's callous watch. Home to mysteries unknown, we ought to see what lies within its walls.

entities.name: Mt.Moonspell
entities.caption: Ancestral home of a fallen clan, now overrun by yokai and oni. In this world where the sun doesn't shine, the night is victorious.

entities.name: Neo Galuga
entities.caption: Join Contra Force to run and gun across the relentlessly horizontal width of Galuga, from the jungle to Neo City and through the horrors lurking beyond. Let's survive determinedly!

entities.name: Ode to Castlevania
entities.caption: As myriad humans from all over the world joined their vespers in unison, the forces of chaos resonated and granted them their dark wish. The King of Terror raises yet again, and with him his demon castle: Castlevania.

entities.name: Polus Replica
entities.caption: Summoned to a mysterious science station amongst the stars, survival is far from certain. Extraterrestrial evil and inter-dimensional duplicity lurk behind every space rock.

entities.name: Red Moon Manor
entities.caption: The mythical place sought by the vile Bloodmoon Clan, said to hide terrible secrets. The relentless pursuit of immortality of its original founders, through atrocious rituals, spawned awful abominations.

entities.name: Space 54
entities.caption: The 54th ritual is complete, and space itself has folded under the weight of an otherworldly will. This veil between cosmic planes is dimensionally misaligned, phasing in unlikely friends, nightmarish foes, and a curio of immense chaotic potential.

entities.name: The Bone Zone
entities.caption: Calcified carnage awaits where the dead go to live. If we speak unholy vespers we will open the way, but should we not go home? Have we not dug too deep?

entities.name: The Coop
entities.caption: A farm for fear itself, the beasts reared here have turned from tasty morsels to terrifying monsters after realising the deadly power of cooperation.

entities.name: The Lycaeum
entities.caption: Myths are murmured of a school submerged beneath a sunlit lake. In silent depths strange fish survive, while at its peak vile evil thrives.

entities.name: Tiny Bridge
entities.caption: Two opposing factions abruptly stopped fighting over this little bridge. No doubt the source of this cessation will turn out to be harmless.

entities.name: Westwoods
entities.caption: Greed's gone green. Arcane avarice is transforming these once serene woods into a ghoulish gambling den. Welcome to the Cursino, where you need not be a vampire to fear the stakes.

entities.name: Whiteout
entities.caption: Arctic mirages and a slow, constant snowstorm make this great glacier a hostile environment. Nonetheless, the myths of a powerful weapon, a mysterious potion, and a cursed woman who hates hot springs, make for strong lures.

entities.name: Awake (IV)
entities.caption: Gives +3 Revivals. Consuming a Revival gives +10% Max Health, +1 Armor, and +5% Might, Area, Duration, and Speed.
entities.unlock: Reach level 50 with Krochi.

entities.name: Beginning (X)
entities.caption: Listed weapons get +1 Amount. The character's main weapon and its evolution gain +3 Amount instead.
entities.unlock: Reach Level 50 with Antonio.

entities.name: Blood Astronomia (XXI)
entities.caption: Listed weapons also emit special damaging zones affected by Amount and Magnet. Enemies within Magnet range take damage based on Amount.
entities.unlock: Reach level 50 with Poe.
entities.notes: Amount affects damage and Magnet affects area.

entities.name: Boogaloo of Illusions (XVIII)
entities.caption: Overall Area continuously changes between -25% and +25% over 10 seconds. The character starts gaining +1% Area every level.
entities.unlock: Reach level 50 with Concetta.
entities.notes: Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of Area.

entities.name: Call of a Mad Moon (XIII)
entities.caption: Effect depends on random results and player stats. Luck: improves Treasure Chests and Light Sources. Growth: improves XP Crystals. Greed: improves gold pickups. Curse: enemies gain MoveSpeed[sic] and Health.
entities.unlock: Reach a Luck bonus of +999% with Chula-Reh.

entities.name: Chaos in the Dark Night (V)
entities.caption: Overall projectile Speed continuously changes between -50% and +50% over 10 seconds. The character starts gaining +1% projectile Speed every level.
entities.unlock: Reach level 50 with Giovanna.
entities.notes: Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of Projectile Speed.

entities.name: Crystal Cries (XII)
entities.caption: Defeating frozen enemies gives bonus MaxHealth[sic], Recovery, and Growth. Triggers an Orologion when health reaches a critically low level.
entities.unlock: Trigger a Starry Heavens with She-Moon Eeta.

entities.name: Disco of Gold (XV)
entities.caption: Picking up coin bags from the floor triggers Gold Fever. Obtaining gold restores as many HP.
entities.unlock: Reaching minute 31 in the Inlaid Library.
entities.notes: Big Coin Bags from Treasure Chests and level ups are also affected.

entities.name: Divine Bloodline (IX)
entities.caption: Armor also affects listed weapons' damage and reflects enemy damage. Character gains bonus damage depending on missing Health. Defeating enemies with retaliatory damage gives +0.5 Max Health.
entities.unlock: Reach Level 50 with Clerici.

entities.name: Edge of the Earth (VIII)
entities.caption: Gives +3 Thorns. Fixes MoveSpeed[sic] to +100%. Allows to walk through walls. Allows to vacuum Treasure Chests, Light Sources, and Weapons.
entities.unlock: Trigger a Lavatrix Machina with Para Kooleo.

entities.name: Game Killer (0)
entities.caption: Halts XP gain. Experience Gems turn into exploding projectiles. All Treasure Chests contain at least 3 items.
entities.unlock: Defeat the final enemy in the Cappella Magna.
entities.notes: Halted XP gain is ignored by Sammy via its gold-to-XP passive.

entities.name: Gemini (I)
entities.caption: Listed weapons come with a counterpart.
entities.unlock: Reach Level 50 with Pugnala.

entities.name: Hail from the Future (X)
entities.caption: Receive one of the listed items when levelling up.
entities.unlock: Trigger a Weird Souls Purifier with Santa Ladonna.

entities.name: Heart of Fire (XIX)
entities.caption: Listed weapon projectiles explode on impact. Light sources explode. Character explodes when damaged.
entities.unlock: Reach level 50 with Arca.
entities.notes: Explosion damage is based on the listed weapons' base damage.

entities.name: Heir of Fate (XIX)
entities.caption: Defeating enemies with FIRE gives bonus MaxHealth[sic] and Might. Triggers an[sic] Nduja Fritta when health reaches a critically low level.
entities.unlock: Survive 15 min in Inverse Boss Rash with Random Events and Random Level Ups.

entities.name: Hidden Anathema (III)
entities.caption: Food pickups grant cumulative bonuses to random stats based on their rarity or healing value.
entities.unlock: Eat as much as possible with Gazebo.

entities.name: Iron Blue Will (VII)
entities.caption: Listed weapon projectiles gain up to 3 bounces and might pass through enemies and walls.
entities.unlock: Reach level 50 with Gennaro.

entities.name: Jail of Crystal (XIV)
entities.caption: Listed weapon projectiles have a chance to freeze enemies.
entities.unlock: Reach Level 50 with Pasqualina.

entities.name: Jaws of a Golden Sky (XIV)
entities.caption: Defeating enemies with listed weapons, or touching them while invincible, has a Luck-based chance to turn them into gold coins. Fever also affects Might.
entities.unlock: Remain invulnerable for 30 s with Amberborne.

entities.name: Lost & Found Painting (XVII)
entities.caption: Overall Duration continuously changes between -50% and +50% over 10 seconds. The character starts gaining +1% Duration every level.
entities.unlock: Reach level 50 with Poppea.
entities.notes: Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of Duration.

entities.name: Mad Groove (VIII)
entities.caption: Every 2 minutes attracts all standard stage items, pickups, and light sources towards the character.
entities.unlock: Reach minute 31 in the Mad Forest.

entities.name: Moonlight Bolero (VI)
entities.caption: An extra treasure boss spawns every minute. The treasure it carries might occasionally contain arcanas and random passive weapons.
entities.unlock: Be embraced by the Darkasso.

entities.name: Out of Bounds (XII)
entities.caption: Freezing enemies generates explosions. Orologions are easier to find. Sorbettos could also be found.
entities.unlock: Reach minute 31 in the Gallo Tower.

entities.name: Pale Diamond Incursion (V)
entities.caption: Listed weapons aim at the nearest enemy. They gain a Cooldown bonus affected by the character's projectile Speed.
entities.unlock: Find 10 Golden Treasure Chests from Zi'Appunta's ability in a single run.

entities.name: Sapphire Mist (I)
entities.caption: All weapons have a chance to fire twice instead of once when activated. The effect is further augmented on listed active weapons.
entities.unlock: Reach a Cooldown bonus of -85% with Space Dude.

entities.name: Sarabande of Healing (VI)
entities.caption: Healing is doubled. Recovering HP damages nearby enemies for the same amount.
entities.unlock: Find the Randomazzo.
entities.notes: Healing from Reviving is also affected.

entities.name: Silent Old Sanctuary (XX)
entities.caption: Gives +3 Reroll, Skip, and Banish. Gives +20% Might and -8% Cooldown for each active weapon slot left empty.
entities.unlock: Reach minute 31 in the Dairy Plant.

entities.name: Slash (XVI)
entities.caption: Enables critical hits for listed weapons. Doubles overall critical damage.
entities.unlock: Reach level 50 with Lama.

entities.name: Stake to Your Heart (0)
entities.caption: Halts XP gain. Enemies drop Gold Coins. Damage is dealt to Gold Coins instead of HP. A special merchant spawns every minute.
entities.unlock: Defeat a Bat Dragon with Big Troubler while using the Game Killer Arcana.
entities.notes: Halted XP gain is ignored by Sammy via its gold-to-XP passive.

entities.name: Tragic Princess (III)
entities.caption: The cooldown of the listed weapons reduces when moving.
entities.unlock: Reach level 50 with Porta.

entities.name: Twilight Requiem (II)
entities.caption: Listed weapon projectiles generate explosions when they expire. Explosions damage is affected by Curse.
entities.unlock: Reach Level 50 with Dommario.

entities.name: Victorian Horror (XVIII)
entities.caption: Enemies within Magnet range receive Greed based damage. Once per life, triggers Cursed World Eater after receiving fatal damage.
entities.unlock: Survive 30 min with no weapons in Inverse Green Acres.

entities.name: Waltz of Pearls (XI)
entities.caption: Listed weapon projectiles gain up to 3 bounces.
entities.unlock: Reach level 50 with Imelda.

entities.name: Wandering the Jet Black (XXI)
entities.caption: Losing health generates exploding projectiles. Explosion damage is increased by total recovered health and Magnet bonus. Explosion Area is increased by Magnet.
entities.unlock: Reach 665 Max Health with Bat Robbert.

entities.name: Wicked Season (XIII)
entities.caption: Overall Growth, Luck, Greed, and Curse are doubled at fixed intervals. The character starts gaining +1% Growth, Luck, Greed, and Curse every 2 levels.
entities.unlock: Reach Level 50 with Christine.
entities.notes: Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of Growth, Luck, Greed, and Curse

entities.name: Antidote
entities.caption: Allows to buy the Defang PowerUp.
entities.location: Due south of Whiteout.

entities.name: Antipyretic
entities.caption: Allows to buy the Fever PowerUp.
entities.location: Biggus Discus

entities.name: Apoplexy
entities.caption: Allows to buy the Charm PowerUp.
entities.location: Appears somewhere near the player at the center of a large square of Diamonds at the 9:00 min mark in Bat Country.

entities.name: Ars Gouda
entities.caption: Permanently allows to access the list of defeated enemies from the main menu.
entities.location: Due south of Dairy Plant.

entities.caption: Fragment of The Directer. The beginning of everything.

entities.caption: Fragment of The Directer. Allows to accumulate XP and level-up.
entities.effects: Allows to accumulate XP and level-up.

entities.effects: Allows to move the character and touch things.

entities.caption: Fragment of the Directer.

entities.name: Aspect of Stone
entities.caption: Fragment of The Directer. Allows to accumulate gold and kills. Handle with care.
entities.effects: Allows to accumulate gold and kills.

entities.name: Aspect of Sun
entities.caption: Fragment of The Directer. Allows to have a health bar.
entities.effects: Allows to have a health bar.

entities.name: Aspect of Volcano
entities.caption: Fragment of The Directer. Allows to have active and passive weapon slots.
entities.effects: Allows to have active and passive weapon slots.

entities.name: Aspect of Wrath
entities.caption: Fragment of the Directer.

entities.name: Astral Stair Map
entities.caption: Displays a detailed map when in Astral Stair.
entities.effects: Displays a map of Astral Stair in the pause menu.
entities.location: Located in Astral Stair.

entities.name: Atlas Gate
entities.caption: Enables base game Adventures.
entities.location: Appears in the center of the arena after 7 min in Boss Rash. Requires the Yellow Sign.

entities.name: Beast Gate
entities.caption: Grants access to a new part of Dracula's Castle.
entities.effects: Opens the entrance to Beelzebub's room of Ode to Castlevania (stage) and enables the warp gate to the Catacombs of Dracula's Castle.
entities.location: Dropped by Eligor, at the Banquet Hall in Dracula's Castle.

entities.name: Black Disk
entities.caption: As you can see, this is a Castlevania Black Disk. Cut number one contains 20 more characters, so please do play it.
entities.effects: Reveals 20 more characters to unlock from Ode to Castlevania, reveals new areas in Ode to Castlevania (stage), and opens the entrance to the Sewers of Dracula's Castle.
entities.location: Top of the right most tower in Ode to Castlevania, after defeating Death.

entities.name: Brave Story
entities.caption: Allows to enable random level up choices.
entities.effects: Adds a Random LevelUp option in the stage selection menu.
entities.location: Appears after 18 min in Space 54.

entities.name: Capra Gate
entities.caption: Allows Mirrors of Truth to materialize and grants access to a new part of Dracula's Castle.
entities.effects: Allows Mirrors of Truth to appear in Ode to Castlevania, opens the entrance to the Outer Walls and Clock Tower of Ode to Castlevania, and enables the warp gate to the Library of Dracula's Castle.
entities.location: Dropped by Paranoia, at the south east entrance of the Library in Dracula's Castle.

entities.name: Castlevania Map
entities.caption: Displays a detailed map when in Ode to Castlevania.
entities.effects: Displays a map of Ode to Castlevania (stage) when paused.
entities.location: Ode to Castlevania

entities.name: Chaos Altemanna
entities.caption: Allows O'Sole Meeo to morph when reaching Level 80.
entities.effects: Morphs O'Sole Meeo at level 80 into a stronger form that evolves its main weapon.
entities.location: Located in Tiny Bridge.

entities.name: Chaos Lazulia
entities.caption: Allows Bianca Ramba to morph when reaching Level 80.
entities.effects: Morphs Bianca Ramba at level 80 into a stronger form that also evolves their main weapon.
entities.location: Carried by a dancer in Mazerella, being dropped once she is defeated in the leftmost wooden side room.

entities.name: Chaos Malachite
entities.caption: Allows Mortaccio to morph when reaching Level 80.
entities.effects: Morphs Mortaccio at level 80 into a stronger form that evolves their main weapon.
entities.location: Appear somewhere near the player at the center of a large square of Diamonds at the 18:00 min mark in Bat Country.

entities.name: Chaos Rosalia
entities.caption: Allows Yatta Cavallo to morph when reaching Level 80.
entities.effects: Morphs Yatta Cavallo at level 80 into a stronger form that evolves their main weapon.
entities.location: Located in Astral Stair.

entities.name: Darkasso
entities.caption: Enables the unlocking and activation of Darkanas.
entities.location: Due south of Room 1665.

entities.name: Ebony and Crimson Stones
entities.caption: Allow Elizabeth Bartley, Count Olrox, Vlad Tepes Dracula, and Death to morph when special conditions are met.
entities.effects: Allows Elizabeth Bartley and Count Olrox to temporarily morph after killing certain amounts of enemies, and allows Vlad Tepes Dracula and Death (character) to morph after reaching level 80. Also reveals their corresponding Megalo forms as secret characters.
entities.location: Very south east of Dracula's Castle in Ode to Castlevania, dropped after defeating Legion.

entities.name: Emerald Disk
entities.caption: Allows entrance to the Emerald Diorama.
entities.effects: Permanently unlocks the Emerald Diorama stage.
entities.location: Found due west of Moongolow and purchasable from Xanthia.

entities.name: Enemahs
entities.caption: Allows to draft new Survarots.
entities.effects: Adds 18 new Survarots to future Survarot drafts.
entities.location: The Lycaeum

entities.name: Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane
entities.caption: Permanently allow you to cast spells and to access the list of secrets from the main menu.
entities.effects: Unlocks the secret menu, which offers instructions to unlock secret characters and the ability to type in spells to unlock most features.
entities.location: Dropped by the Sketamari due south of The Bone Zone.

entities.name: Glass Vizard
entities.caption: Summons the merchant in all stages.
entities.effects: The Merchant now appears in all stages.
entities.location: Sold by the merchant in Moongolow.

entities.name: Gracia's Mirror
entities.caption: Permanently allows to access a harder version of any stage.
entities.location: Given after entering Eudaimonia Machine and choosing the "Too Easy" option. If the "Too Hard" option had been chosen instead, start and quit a run in endless mode, go back to Eudaimonia Machine and it will be given.

entities.name: Great Gospel
entities.caption: Permanently allows to level up weapons beyond their limit. Can be enabled in stage selection.
entities.location: Dropped by the final enemy in Cappella Magna (requires the Yellow Sign).

entities.name: Green Eyes Vizard
entities.caption: Allows to see and be seen by Bat Dragons.
entities.effects: Allows Bat Dragons to be found in Il Molise and Mad Forest.
entities.location: The Lycaeum

entities.name: Grim Grimoire
entities.caption: Permanently allows to peek at discovered weapon evolutions and unions from the pause menu.
entities.effects: Unlocks the "Open Grimoire" menu in the pause menu.
entities.location: Due west of Inlaid Library.

entities.name: Joker Disk
entities.caption: Allows entrance to the Ante Chamber.
entities.effects: Permanently unlocks the Ante Chamber stage.
entities.location: Found due west of Moongolow and purchasable from Xanthia.

entities.name: King's Gate
entities.caption: Allows Neutron Bombs to materialize and grants access to a new part of Dracula's Castle.
entities.effects: Allows Neutron Bombs to appear in Ode to Castlevania (stage), opens the entrance to the Throne Room of Ode to Castlevania (stage), and enables the warp gate to the Clock Tower of Dracula's Castle.
entities.location: Dropped by Abbadon, at the top of the Clock Tower in Dracula's Castle.

entities.name: Lake Foscari Map
entities.caption: Displays a detailed map when in Lake Foscari.
entities.effects: Displays a map of Lake Foscari when paused.
entities.location: Due north east of Lake Foscari.

entities.name: Magic Banger
entities.caption: Permanently allows to change music in Stage Selection.
entities.location: Due northeast of Green Acres.

entities.name: Masquerade
entities.caption: Unlocks Party Mode
entities.location: Due west of Westwoods.

entities.name: Milky Way Map
entities.caption: Permanently enables the map in the pause menu.
entities.effects: Unlocks the map in the pause menu.
entities.location: Due south of Dairy Plant.

entities.name: Mindbender
entities.caption: Permanently allows to change character appearance (where applicable), maximum weapon loadout, and favorite characters.
entities.effects: Unlocks cosmetic options when clicking on certain characters in the character selection menu and allows to set the maximum number of weapons.
entities.location: Fill 50 entries in the Collection.

entities.name: Mt.Moonspell Map
entities.caption: Displays a detailed map when in Mt.Moonspell.
entities.effects: Displays a map of Mt.Moonspell when paused.
entities.location: Due north east of Mt.Moonspell.

entities.name: Neo Galuga Map
entities.caption: Displays a detailed map when in Neo Galuga.
entities.effects: Displays a map of Neo Galuga when paused.
entities.location: Neo Galuga

entities.name: Pile of Secrets
entities.caption: Allows to discover a little pile of new secrets.
entities.effects: Reveals more secrets to unlock from Ode to Castlevania. Also makes more Boss Traps appear in Ode to Castlevania (stage).
entities.location: Very north west of Dracula's Castle in Ode to Castlevania, dropped after defeating Beelzebub.

entities.name: Polus Replica Map
entities.caption: Displays a detailed map when in Polus Replica.
entities.effects: Displays a map of Polus Replica when paused.
entities.location: Located in Polus Replica.

entities.name: Randomazzo
entities.caption: Enables the unlocking and the activation of Arcanas.
entities.location: Due north of Gallo Tower.

entities.name: Red Moon Manor Map
entities.caption: Displays a detailed map when in Red Moon Manor.
entities.effects: Displays a map of Red Moon Manor when paused.

entities.name: Roast Chicken with a Clock in the Middle
entities.page: Roast Chicken with a Clock in the Middle
entities.caption: Permanently allows you to speed up gameplay.
entities.effects: Unlocks a button that speeds up gameplay.
entities.location: Located due east of The Coop.

source.title: Roast Chicken with a Clock in the Middle

entities.name: Scorpion Gate
entities.caption: Allows Karma Coins to materialize and grants access to a new part of Dracula's Castle.
entities.effects: Allows Karma Coins to appear in Ode to Castlevania (stage), opens the entrance to the Library and Stairway of Ode to Castlevania (stage), and enables the warp gate to the Laboratory of Dracula's Castle.
entities.location: Dropped by Puppet Master, at the south east corner of the Laboratory in Dracula's Castle.

entities.name: Serpent Gate
entities.caption: Allows clockwork weapons to materialize and grants access to a new part of Dracula's Castle.
entities.effects: Allows Endo Gears, Peri Pendulum, Myo Lift and Epi Head to appear in Ode to Castlevania (stage), opens the entrance to the Ice Cave, Catacombs and the eastmost areas of Ode to Castlevania (stage), and enables the warp gate to the Sewer of Dracula's Castle.
entities.location: Dropped by Menace, in the right side of Sewer in Dracula's Castle.

entities.name: Seventh Trumpet
entities.caption: Permanently allows to disable all reapers and fight endlessly.
entities.location: Given after entering Eudaimonia Machine and choosing the "Too Hard" option. If the "Too Easy" option had been chosen instead, start and quit a run in inverse mode, go back to Eudaimonia Machine and it will be given.

entities.name: Sorceress' Tears
entities.caption: Permanently allows to speed up time in Stage Selection.
entities.location: Due south of Gallo Tower.

entities.name: Stallion Gate
entities.caption: Allows Heart Refreshes to materialize and grants access to a new part of Dracula's Castle.
entities.effects: Allows Heart Refreshes to appear in Ode to Castlevania (stage), opens the entrance to the Gallery and Laboratory of Ode to Castlevania, and enables the warp gate to the front door of Dracula's Castle.
entities.location: Dropped upon defeating the Giant Bat at the end of the First Hallway in Dracula's Castle.

entities.name: Survarocchi
entities.caption: Allows to find Survarots in light sources.
entities.effects: Allows making Survarot cards obtainable from light sources.
entities.location: The Lycaeum

entities.name: Trisection
entities.caption: Enables random events in all stages.
entities.effects: Adds a Random Events option in the Stage Selection menu.
entities.location: Located at the end of the bottom path of Astral Stair.

entities.name: Wax Fetish
entities.caption: Allows you to buy the Preserve PowerUp.
entities.location: Carried by a dancer in Mazerella, being dropped once he is defeated in the rightmost wooden side room.

entities.name: Wood Carving Score
entities.caption: Summons the Master Librarian in any stage.
entities.effects: The Master Librarian now appears in all stages.
entities.location: South East from the starting point of Ode to Castlevania (stage).

entities.name: Yellow Sign
entities.caption: Permanently allows to detect hidden items in all stages.
entities.effects: Unlocks the Silver Ring, Gold Ring, Metaglio Left, and Metaglio Right. Also enables certain hidden relics and events.
entities.location: Due east of Holy Forbidden.

entities.name: Amount
entities.caption: Fires 1 more projectile (all weapons).

entities.name: Area
entities.caption: Augments area of attacks by 5% per rank (max +10%).

entities.name: Armor (stat)
entities.caption: Reduces incoming damage by 1 per rank (max -3).

entities.name: Banish
entities.caption: Twice per rank, allows you to remove an item from level up choices, for the rest of the run.

entities.name: Charm
entities.caption: Increases enemies spawn quantity by 20 per rank (max +100).

entities.name: Cooldown
entities.caption: Uses weapons 2.5% faster per rank (max 5%).

entities.name: Curse
entities.caption: Increase enemy speed, health, quantity, and frequency by 10% per rank (max +50%).

entities.name: Defang
entities.caption: 3% of enemies spawn unable to deal damage per rank (max 15%).

entities.name: Duration
entities.caption: Effects from weapons last 15% longer per rank (max +30%).

entities.name: Fever
entities.caption: Increases duration of Gold Fever and Gold Finger by 5% per rank (max +25%).

entities.name: Greed
entities.caption: Gains 10% more Gold per rank (max +50%).

entities.name: Growth
entities.caption: Gains 3% more experience per rank (max 15%).

entities.name: Luck
entities.caption: Chance to get lucky goes up by 10% per rank (max +30%).

entities.name: Magnet
entities.caption: Items Pickup range +25% per rank (max +50%).

entities.name: Max Health
entities.caption: Augments Max Health by 10% per rank (max +30%).

entities.name: Might
entities.caption: Raises inflicted damage by 5% per rank (max +25%).

entities.name: Move Speed
entities.caption: Character moves 5% faster per rank (max 10%).

entities.name: Omni
entities.caption: Increases Might, Projectile Speed, Duration, and Area by 2% per rank (max +10%).

entities.name: Preserve
entities.caption: Reroll, Skip, and Banish actions have a 10% chance to be preserved per rank (max 50%).

entities.name: Recovery
entities.caption: Recovers 0.1 HP per rank (max 0.5) per second.

entities.name: Reroll
